correctness.rationale: Every derivation preserves the center, forcing any local derivation to preserve Kz. Conversely, the evaluation map from the symplectic Lie algebra to V at any nonzero vector is surjective, so each noncentral vector has a matching derivation; central vectors are matched by a conformal symplectic map with the required multiplier. The dimension formulas follow from dim sp(V,omega)=n(2n+1), dim csp(V,omega)=n(2n+1)+1, and the block form of center-preserving endomorphisms.

value.rationale: This gives a complete local-to-global classification for a standard family of nilpotent Lie algebras, quantifies the exact gap between local derivations and derivations in every dimension, and resolves the characteristic-two boundary for this family. The result is stronger than a single witness and provides a reusable benchmark for broader local-derivation questions.
